query.statement: INSERT INTO TB_TRADEMARK (TRADEMARK_ID, NAME, STATUS_CD, CREATED_BY, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_BY, UPDATED_AT) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, SYSDATE, ?, SYSDATE)
SELECT TRADEMARK_ID, NAME, STATUS_CD, UPDATED_AT FROM TB_TRADEMARK WHERE NAME LIKE '%' || ? || '%' AND STATUS_CD = ? ORDER BY UPDATED_AT DESC
SELECT TRADEMARK_ID, NAME, STATUS_CD, CREATED_BY, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_BY, UPDATED_AT FROM TB_TRADEMARK WHERE TRADEMARK_ID = ?
UPDATE TB_TRADEMARK SET NAME = ?, STATUS_CD = ?, UPDATED_BY = ?, UPDATED_AT = SYSDATE WHERE TRADEMARK_ID = ?
